```{r init}
#| include: false

library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
theme_set(theme_bw())
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

SITE <- params$SITE
PATH <- params$DROPBOX
CURRENT <- "current_data"

if(SITE %in% c("PTR", "CRC", "OWC", "SWH", "GWI", "MSM", "GCW", "DLG")) {
  SUBPATH <- "COMPASS_PNNL_Data"
} else if(site %in% c("TMP")) {
  SUBPATH <- "TEMPEST_PNNL_Data"
  CURRENT <- "Current_data" # you're killing me, Roy
} else {
  stop("Unknown site: ", site)
}

```

Data path: `r PATH`

Data folder: `r SUBPATH`

Current data: `r CURRENT`

```{r helpers}
#| include: false

no_data_check <- function(x, what) {
  message(nrow(x), " data rows")
  if(nrow(x) == 0) {
    cat('::: {.callout-important appearance="simple"}',
        '## No Data',
        '',
        paste('No data files were found for', what),
        '',
        ':::', sep = "\n")
  }
}

read_files <- function(type,
                       site = SITE, 
                       path = PATH,
                       subpath = SUBPATH,
                       current = CURRENT) {

  files <- list.files(file.path(path, subpath, current), 
                      pattern = paste0("_", site, "_.*_", type),
                      full.names = TRUE)
  message("Found ", length(files), " files")
  
  x <- lapply(files, function(f) {
    txt <- read_lines(f)
    read_csv(I(txt[c(-1, -3, -4)]), show_col_types = FALSE)
  })
  names(x) <- basename(files)
  x %>% 
    bind_rows() %>% 
    pivot_longer(-1:-4)
}

```

# Sapflow

```{r read-sf}
#| output: "asis"
sf <- read_files("Sapflow")
no_data_check(sf, "Sapflow")
```

```{r}
sf %>% 
  filter(name != "BattV_Avg") %>%  # probably we don't care about this
  separate(Statname, into = c("X", "Site", "Plot")) %>% 
  mutate(port = gsub("DiffVolt._Avg\\(", "", name),
         port = as.integer(gsub(")", "", port)),
         port = as.factor(port)) -> 
  sf

p <- ggplot(sf, aes(TIMESTAMP, value, color = port)) +
  facet_grid(Plot ~ .) +
  geom_point(na.rm = TRUE)
print(p)

p <- p + ylim(c(0, 1)) + ggtitle("Data in 0-1 range only")
print(p)
```
